title: Chu Tsung

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

May 15th 1916.

Sir,
Special precautions were taken at the Arsenal yesterday
when the firing by the S.V.C. at Yangtsepoo was heard.
It is reported that some soldiers went to a shop
in Pah Da Deu 八大圖 Pootung on 14th instant and ordered
some rice on credit. The shopkeeper declined to accomodate
them and a quarrel arose. Finally a headman of the
village went security for the soldiers and they
were supplied. The situation was grave for a time
and the people of the village were greatly alarmed.
It is reported that a rebel leader named Chu Tsung 朱正
has received instructions from the rebels in Shantung
to proceed to that province with his followers.
Chen Chi Mei and his party are very jealous because
of this.
It is reported that several rice boats bound from
Wusieh and Zangchow for Shanghai have been robbed.
In consequence of this other rice boats are afraid to come
and a big increase in the price of rice may result.
Brigadier General Wong Ping 王宏 an officer of
the Shanghai garrison, left for Nanking on 14th inst.
At present there are about thirty boats containing
several hundred rebels on the Chekiang side of the Tahoo
Lake. These are the men who were driven away from Wukiang
by Government troops. They are apparently not
recognised by the Chekiang Authorities who decline
to disperse them or take control over them and the
Military Authorities of this province cannot take any
action without upsetting the arrangement made to keep
the northern troops for the time being, away from the
territory which is under the jurisdiction of the
Authorities of Chekiang.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on M.S. May 16.

17/5716

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

1916年5月15日。

先生：

昨日听到杨树浦上海义勇队（S.V.C.）的枪声时，兵工厂已采取特别预防措施。

据报，本月14日，一些士兵前往浦东八大图的一家商店，要求赊购大米。店主拒绝通融，遂发生争吵。最后由该村一名头目为士兵作保，他们才买到了大米。局势一度严峻，村民大为惊恐。

据报，一名名为朱正（Chu Tsung）的反叛首领已收到山东反叛分子的指示，将率其追随者前往该省。

陈其美及其党羽对此甚为嫉妒。

据报，数艘从吴淞和常州驶往上海的运米船遭抢劫。因此，其他运米船不敢前来，可能导致米价大幅上涨。

上海驻军军官王宏（Wong Ping）准将于本月14日启程前往南京。

目前，太湖浙江一侧约有三十艘船只，载有数百名反叛分子。这些人是被政府军从吴江驱赶至此的。浙江当局显然不予承认，既不愿将其驱散，也不愿对其实施管控；而本省军事当局若不破坏暂使北方军队远离浙江当局管辖区域的安排，便无法采取任何行动。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）
总探长。

警务处总监。

5月16日录入工部局档案。
